LESSON: KNITTING SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Knitting Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Knitting Skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Knitting Skills
2. give Kenyan examples of Knitting Skills
3. practise a safe skill for Knitting Skills

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Knitting Skills

Teach
• Observe Knitting Skills in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Knitting Skills (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Knitting Skills.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Knitting Skills.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Knitting Skills.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Knitting Skills.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Knitting Skills: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Knitting Skills with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
